budget_items.what_was_recorded: Public comment reported the School Building Committee is considering spending four million dollars of contingency funding; a citizen email questioned discretionary spending.
budget_items.quote: the school building committee is considering spending the four million dollars of contingency funding.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: An accounts payable warrant was signed in the stated amount.
budget_items.quote: an accounts payable warrant in the amount of $644,219.92 was signed.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: School Committee renewed FY2017-2019 transportation contracts with a $40,000 increase due to a state-mandated sick-time payment; no cost increase in the Special Education contract.
budget_items.quote: there was a $40,000 increase in the contract as the vendor has reported the state mandated it pay its part-time employees for sick time.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Master Teacher projects are approved annually with a stipend for approximately 100 hours of work.
budget_items.quote: these projects are approved annually and a $5000 stipend is awarded for approximately 100 hours of work.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Board of Health septic/sewer loans are written at a low interest rate with a betterment placed on the property.
budget_items.quote: loans are written with two percent interest rates and a betterment placed on the property.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Third amendment adds the Town of Stow; the minutes state there are no additional costs to the Town.
budget_items.quote: there are no additional costs to the town for this.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: MART service changed to five 45-minute loops per day at no added cost to the Town.
budget_items.quote: to provide additional service without added cost, mart is going from seven, 30 minute loops to five, 45 minute loops per day.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Town Manager to lease the building to current tenants at a cost to cover building maintenance expenses; the school is proposing no FY2017 operating or maintenance funds for it.
budget_items.quote: continue to lease that building to the current tenants at a cost to cover the building maintenance expenses.
